data: What is the UAS value of the blue dotted line in the bottom right graph at 12K number of trees?

The question asks for the UAS value of the blue dotted line in the bottom right graph at 12K number of trees. The bottom right graph corresponds to the Russian development treebank. The blue dotted line represents the 100-d model. At 12K number of trees, the blue dotted line appears to be around 85 on the UAS scale. Therefore, the UAS value of the blue dotted line in the bottom right graph at 12K number of trees is approximately 85.
